title: Chapter 56 Village Head Group
content:
Chapter 56 Village Head Group

The [Trading Shop] has been closed, and the items previously consigned have been returned to the player's backpack.

The [Synthetic Formula] column has not changed, but the production of items no longer has automatic construction. People must personally participate in the construction with the help of the system, and the labor and time costs increase.

This change can be said to have a great impact on players.

However, as long as players build villages and develop as a team, this problem can be easily overcome.

Open the default [Chat Channel].

At this time, the number of players in the [Changping County Lords Channel] began to increase, and now it has reached more than 200 people.

Players started to speak one after another.

Xiao Huihui: "Hello everyone, I'm Xiao Huihui. I'm a newcomer. Please take care of me."

Wang Shuo was instantly amused when he saw this statement.

My heavy heart was relieved a lot.

Wang Shuo did some research and found that each village chief could change his nickname and hide his ID.

Is it because they are afraid of discovering the other party's location and causing unnecessary conflicts?

Wang Shuo decided to give himself a nickname to avoid exposure.

After thinking about it, he changed his nickname to "Red Panda" so that he would look less likely to attract hatred.

"So, we are a group of village chiefs?"

"Isn't it a group of lords?"

"I think they are still a group of village chiefs, very down-to-earth!"

"+1"

"+1"

…

"I would like to ask, do you all adopt the cooperative system?"

"What cooperative system?"

"It's a village that a few of us joined together to build."

"I'm sorry, I just stole the heart of their sanctuary and built the village."

"Survival of the fittest, survival of the fittest. If the weak build a village, they will lead everyone to perish together. It is better to rely on the strong."

Northeast Big Tiger: "You're right, I'm at Scarborough Market, 60 kilometers south. Everyone is welcome to come and join us!"

This operation surprised me. Advertisements are so pervasive!

Moreover, he completely exposed the location of his territory, and he didn't know whether it was good or bad.

"What do you think about the changes to system functions?"

Skateboard Shoes: "What do you think? Of course I firmly support Mr. Zach's decision. We must deeply understand Mr. Zach's intention and play a solid role in the next..."

Seeing everyone chatting calmly in front of him, Wang Shuo felt a little unreal.

Could it be that I think too darkly about this world?

Wang Shuo fell into deep thought as to whether his method was too radical.

After closing the chat channel, Wang Shuo fell asleep quickly after a tiring day.

In his sleep, Wang Shuo dreamed again that he was being chased by a huge army. He was leading the Gong Zheng brothers and was running away, but in the end he was shot through the heart by an arrow from the enemy.

When he woke up the next day, he found that the bed was wet.

He immediately patted his chest and took a deep breath.

In this dangerous world, there is no peace at all. We must pursue strong force to ensure safety.

Wang Shuo firmly believed in this idea. After getting up, he went to the yard and began to practice the "Wandering Dragon Spear Technique".

The upgrade of Youlong Qianjue mainly relies on proficiency. As long as you follow the prescribed actions and perform basic move training or fighting such as stabbing, tapping, picking, blocking, and smashing, you can increase your proficiency.

After Wang Shuo completed a complete set of actions, his proficiency increased by 10 points.

After putting away his gun, Wang Shuo planned to have breakfast with his fellow citizens.

Last night, Wang Shuo had already discovered Zhou Yuke, a citizen of the territory who was a chef, and asked him to be responsible for the cooking tasks in the territory. He also assigned him an assistant to do odd jobs for him.

After a night of calming down, many residents have begun to adapt to this kind of life.

Wang Shuo assigned the newly joined citizens to the craftsman group and the reserve group respectively, and then assigned tasks again.

Today's main task is to build residential buildings. Wang Shuo selected two more people as Gu Liji's assistants to be responsible for the security of the territory.

Wang Shuo continued to lead his cavalry squad to search in the other three directions of Wana Village.

After Wang Shuo left, the people in the territory became restless.

In particular, there are some residents who refuse to obey orders and act in a perfunctory manner when working.

On the construction site, Suo Yong was arranging work in an orderly manner, when a discordant sound sounded.

"You just accept your fate so calmly? In my opinion, our lords are nothing more than that. There are only four of them, and there are more than 40 of us, so there is no need to be afraid of him."

The speaker was Mao Qiang, a newcomer who just joined the territory last night.

He has reached level 4 and was among the top 10 players in the novice trial. Now being captured by Wang Shuo, he is naturally a little unconvinced.

However, he does not have any special skills, and his life skill is also that of a lumberjack.

Therefore, Wang Shuo did not receive special attention.

Suo Yong shouted sternly: "Mao Qiang, do you know what you are talking about? We have signed a contract."

Mao Qiang said nonchalantly: "Contract? That oath full of loopholes is almost as good as no oath. We just said we would obey his orders, but who stipulated how we should fulfill his orders?"

"Besides, the oath doesn't stipulate that you can't overthrow him or kill him, right!"

"Look, now that I've said this, isn't it okay?"

Mao Qiang's remarks attracted the attention of many people in the territory.

"It seems to be true. Yesterday, I saw a player being wiped out by the system because he hid something. I was scared!" A person in the territory patted his chest with lingering fear.

"He asked us to build houses. As long as we are building, it is not considered to be against his orders. The system vows not to care about anything else. Is that what you mean?" Another player said loudly.

"Haha, yes!"

And Guliji stood at the edge of the crowd, listening to all this silently, and did not intend to stop them.

At the same time, Wang Shuo was shocked and felt that something had happened on his territory attribute panel.

Wang Shuo found the population attribute and clicked it, and the information of all the people in the territory appeared.

As a result, the loyalty of the people in the territory has changed dramatically.

The loyalty of many players has dropped to around 60, and Mao Qiang's has dropped directly to 51.

It seems that this person is really a wolf cub who can't be fed and is born to rebel.

Wang Shuo sped up and captured 4 more people before returning directly to Wana Village.

As soon as he arrived at the entrance of the village, Guliji came over. Wang Shuo didn't let her speak, but went straight into the hall.

Guliji reported to Wang Shuo about Mao Qiang's reactionary remarks. Since other people did not have more radical behaviors, she did not take any action.

"You did a good job." Wang Shuo smiled at her.

"It seems that people's hearts are separated from their stomachs. It is really difficult to build trust!"

"Agui, do you have a good plan?"

"Lord, you can do this..."

"Well, good, you kid, you are finally useful."
